key_message: A private car turns four scattered stops into one unbroken day.

threads.text:
Four names arrive in my inbox most weeks. Gamcheon. Haedong Yonggungsa. Jagalchi. Gwangalli.

Then a second message, usually a day later: which one should we cut?

That second one is the whole job. Nobody flies to Busan to choose between a hillside and a temple, and with your own car and driver you don't have to.

Which one would you have cut?

Ask us for a route: https://www.sojournkorea.net/private-tour

#Busan

linkedin.text:
Relocation packages cover the flight and the apartment. They don't cover the Saturday.

A colleague's parents fly in. A visiting team has one open day. Someone ends up building a Busan itinerary in a group chat at 11pm.

The stops they ask for sit in four corners of the city, so the plan rarely survives.

A private car and a custom route hand the sequencing to someone else.

Plan a visit for your team or family:
https://www.sojournkorea.net/private-tour

#Busan #ExpatLife #RelocationSupport

thread: The test of a Busan day isn't how it starts. It's whether you're still out at Gwangalli when the bridge lights come on.

The full-day route is arranged to get you there. Gamcheon, then Jagalchi and Gukje, then Haedong Yonggungsa, then Sky Capsule and the bay. Private car, custom order, nothing dropped to keep a schedule.
